# ZMP map fixtures

**Origin**: `Maps/sas.maps/` of a stock SAS.Planet install,
copied verbatim on 2026-09-17.

**How sliced**: not sliced — this is the *entire* stock map corpus shipped with the live install
(514 `.zmp` entries), copied recursively with `cp -a` to preserve exact directory structure,
filenames and file bytes. Total on-disk size ~10 MB (mostly filesystem block overhead from many
small files; actual byte content is ~3.2 MB per `du -sb`).

**Format note (important divergence from ticket wording)**: in this live install, `.zmp` map
definitions are **plain directories** named `*.zmp` (not zip archives), each containing:
- `params.txt` — key/value map definition (`[PARAMS]` section: name, GUID, URL template,
  projection, cache folder name, content type, etc.), UTF-8 with BOM.
- `18.bmp` / `24.bmp` — toolbar icon bitmaps (present on some maps, not all).
- `GetUrlScript.txt` — PascalScript source for maps whose tile URL needs computation
  (random subdomain selection, coordinate transforms, signed URLs, etc.). Present on 350 of the
  514 maps; absent on 164, which use only the static `DefURLBase` template in `params.txt`.

Legacy SAS.Planet also supports `.zmp` as an actual zip archive (same internal layout, zipped) —
none were found on this install; only the extracted-directory form is present. If a zipped sample
is needed later, it is not available from either source in this ticket and should be flagged.

**What it exercises**:
- FEAT items for map-source parsing (`params.txt` key/value format, per-key types, GUID parsing).
- FEAT items for the PascalScript interpreter (ADR-0003 corpus): all 350 real `GetUrlScript.txt`
  scripts observed in the wild, covering `RegExprReplaceMatchSubStr`, `Random`, `inttostr`,
  string concatenation of `GetURLBase`/`GetX`/`GetY`/`GetZ`, and other legacy SAS API calls.
- Directory/menu nesting (`ParentSubMenu`, `ParentSubMenu_<lang>`) and localized captions.

**index.csv**: one row per `.zmp` directory (`name` = path relative to `zmp/sas.maps/`,
`needs_script` = whether `GetUrlScript.txt` is present, `script_line_count` = line count of that
file, 0 when absent). 350 `yes` rows, 164 `no` rows — matches the corpus-wide count in CHARTER.md
section 10/11 (514 stock maps, 350 need PascalScript).

**projection_expected.csv** (T-0016, geo slice A): one row per `.zmp` directory (`name`, `class` =
expected `IProjectionType` concrete class, `projectionEpsg`, `datumEpsg`, `radiusA`/`radiusB` = the
raw `sradiusa`/`sradiusb` read from `params.txt` after defaulting). Generated by
`tools/gen_projection_expected.py`, which transcribes docs/specs/geo.md §2.3
(`DatumFactory::byRadius`) and §2.4 (`ProjectionTypeFactory::byConfig`) in Python and evaluates it
against every `params.txt` in this directory. Regenerate with:

```
tools/gen_projection_expected.py            # rewrites the CSV
tools/gen_projection_expected.py --check    # regenerates in memory and diffs; exit 1 on mismatch
```

**This is a cross-check, not an independent oracle.** It is a second transcription of the same
§2.3/§2.4 pseudo-code that the C++ factory also implements, by the same author, and the legacy
Windows binary was never run to confirm either one. Its value is in catching a divergence between
the C++ and the spec text and in pinning a regression under `tests/geo/zmp_projection_corpus_test.cpp`
— not in proving the resolved values against ground truth. See that test file's header comment for
the four cases it drives from this CSV.

**Zipped `.zmp` (T-0061)**: `zipped/Gps_tiles_deflated.zmp` and `zipped/Gps_tiles_stored.zmp` are NOT shipped
by the live install (it has no zipped ZMP). They are generated by `make_zipped_zmp.py` (Python `zipfile`, fixed
timestamps) from the unchanged stock folder `sas.maps/_osm/Gps_tiles.zmp/`: a `EmptyTiles/` directory entry plus
every file, '/' separators, no leading folder (layout of `zip -r`); one with all members deflated, one stored.
Regenerate only with the script; byte equality of the deflated file is not guaranteed across machines (zlib build, `create_system` of the OS). No test depends on the bytes, only on the members read back.

**Set fixtures (T-0072)**: `duplicate/{a,b}.zmp` are two copies of the stock `sas.maps/_osm/4umaps.eu.zmp` (its `params.txt` and `24.bmp`, unchanged): the same GUID twice, for the duplicate-GUID message of `ZmpInfoSet`.
`hidden/visible.zmp` is the same stock copy; `hidden/.hidden.zmp` is the same copy with the last hex digit of the GUID changed (`...117E` to `...117F`) so that, were the hidden name not dropped, the set would show two maps.

**Maps.ini**: verbatim copy of `Maps/Maps.ini` of a stock SAS.Planet install (written by legacy SAS.Planet, `Lang=en`, 514 sections, UTF-8 with BOM) taken 2026-10-12, the oracle for GUID and `MapName_` of the 514 stock ZMPs. It matched the corpus with no difference (no fixture-age exception to record).

**corpus_aggregates.csv**: one row per `.zmp` folder with the typed fields of docs/specs/maptype.md 7.2 step 5 (`isLayer`, `Ext`, `CacheType`, `DetectContentType`, `UseDwn`, `IsUseDownloaderInScript`, `MaxConnectToServerCount`, `IteratorSubRectSize`, `UseMemCache`, `separator`, `[ViewInfo] EPSG`, number of `EmptyTiles`/`BanTiles` files, own `18.bmp`, non-empty `info.txt`). Generated by `tools/gen_zmp_corpus_aggregates.py`, a plain line-based reader that shares no code with the port or with `gen_projection_expected.py`; `--check` regenerates in memory and diffs. Note: `Lantmateriet.se.zmp` has a byte-identical `18.bmp` and `24.bmp`, which is why the test compares the 18 icon with the size in its own BMP header, not with the 24 icon.

**zipped_nodwn/Gps_tiles_nodwn.zmp** (T-0072): the stored zip of `Gps_tiles.zmp` with the single line `UseDwn=0` appended to `params.txt` (made by `make_zipped_zmp.py`, which also rewrites the two `zipped/` files byte-identically); for the "downloader off: the set does not read the script" test.
